business_problem: Machina Sports needed to deliver low-latency live-sports experiences to large concurrent fan audiences while staying flexible enough to swap models, ground answers in fresh information, and expand multimodal features without stitching together multiple AI vendors.
solution_summary: Machina Sports built its fan-engagement platform on Google Cloud using Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform and related Gemini services as the core of a live, multimodal sports experience. Gemini Flash Lite handles fast conversational responses during matches, while Grounding with Google Search brings in fresh updates and Model Garden gives the team a simple way to test and switch models without rewriting code. Cloud Storage backs content and assets, and Gemini's Context Caching reduces repeated prompt-processing overhead during long fan sessions. The team also uses Priority Pay-As-You-Go endpoints to shave response wait times and is extending the platform with Google Kubernetes Engine for custom open models and future features such as personalized AI audio commentary and what-if match simulations. This unified stack lets Machina Sports keep latency low during live events while expanding richer fan experiences on one platform.
